fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/install -run TestInstallScript runs the repo-root install.sh against a local fixture channel (base URL override): it installs a working rhiza for the host platform, --channel latest picks the latest manifest, and a tampered archive fails with nothing installed; the same test runs sh -n install.sh, so make check covers the script's syntax with no extra tool
fields.statement: install.sh, run as curl -fsSL <raw URL> | sh, installs the newest release (or --channel latest) for the running linux or darwin on amd64 or arm64 into ~/.local/bin or --dir, verifying the archive sha256 against the channel manifest and failing on a mismatch
